source.title: The pricing of jump and diffusive risks in the cross-section of cryptocurrency returns

specification.market_factor: Equal-weight hourly return across contemporaneously available panel assets.
specification.signal: Negative lagged rolling OLS residual variance using var(asset)-cov(asset,market)^2/var(market).
specification.rebalance: Weekly Monday 00:00 UTC; current open execution using statistics through prior completed hour.
specification.construction: Equal-weight long lowest-idiosyncratic-risk tercile / short highest-idiosyncratic-risk tercile, 0.5 gross per side.

pbo: N/A: development gate failed before OOS portfolio evaluation.
failure_analysis: The canonical signal met the IC magnitude/significance condition but failed the preregistered low-minus-high portfolio-spread condition. All three estimation windows produced negative low-minus-high development spreads, so the untouched 2024-2025 OOS was not consumed.
conclusion: REJECT. The development gate failed; preserve OOS and move to a materially different mechanism.
